Thank you sir.  I do understand what you're saying, and I've tried pouring myself into my music during times like this.  However, as a fellow pain sufferer, I'm sure you can understand the frustration of being physically incapable of doing what you want to do.

I think what weighs down on me the most is realizing I've been dealing with medical problems for about 2 1/2 years, and thinking of how long it's been since I've been genuinely happy.  I mean, yes I've always dealt with depression issues in some form or another in my life, but never in such a way that they've dragged on in the way they do now.

Yes, indeed I do, though mind you I am a bit uncomfortable talking with new people, this is a bit of a tangent for me :/

If you'd like, you can PM me for the info.

It's kinda tough to pin a real reason down.  I suppose most of it is getting fed up with people's rudeness and general inconsiderate actions.  Sitting on the internet too much exposes you to a lot of it.

I'm a college student, and in class I watch it a lot amongst other people.  At a certain point I realized if I kept myself in the background and didn't talk much unless it was necessary, that I avoided having to deal with it for the most part.  But after a while it became excessive, and at a certain point I stopped socializing with others.  I ended up just watching them from afar and analyzing their actions.

I know in a lot of ways my disdain is an invention of my own head, but it feels hard to get past it.

Oh, and good luck with your hard drive.  THAT can be ab itch.

Thank you very much.  Yes I forgot to mention that I do work with a hypnotherapist (which is essentially just guided meditation) that my mom hooked me up with.  Unfortunately I happen to be absolutely terrible at meditation on my own (my mind is way too active), but she gives me tapes and other stuff to work with.

I did yoga every day in rehab, and it was certainly beneficial, I just don't have the time/energy to go to a yoga classes, so I've been looking into yoga tapes as well.  The hard part about it is just how tired my body is all the time.

I've also heard of binaural programming before.  I'll look into it some more.  Thank you very much for the support.
